items.q: Where do I access my training?
items.a: Training delivery and your coaching account stay in FITR. Use the official FITR access link; this website does not sync workouts or private client records.

items.q: Is this suitable for my first HYROX?
items.a: Use the free preparation guides to get familiar with the race, then ask the coaching team which support fits your current training and goal.

items.q: What training options and prices are available?
